messages:
Maria G: Quick sync on the postmortem actions for last week's delayed token ingest — want to lock owners and realistic dates. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-2026-delay :spiral_calendar:
Ajay K: I can own the root-cause follow-up (ingest pipeline checkpointing). Will have a draft RCA by Thu EOD. :+1:
Chen W: I pulled logs, looks like intermittent S3 list delays caused a backlog that compounded overnight. Need infra owner to verify rate limits and retries.
Samir P: tagging infra — I can run a replay on the staging stream and validate retry windows. ETA Mon.
Lisa (FinOps): For invoices that went out yesterday with under-counted tokens, we need a containment plan for credits + reissued invoices. Finance needs a list of affected accounts by Tuesday COB.
Maria G: Action items so far:
• Ajay — RCA and fix proposal for checkpoint resilience (owner) — Thu EOD
• Samir — replay + verification on staging, propose throttling/parallelism knobs — Mon
• Chen — small script to surface delta-accumulation per customer for last 7 days — Tue
• Lisa — list of affected invoices + draft credit memo wording — Tue COB
Please confirm if dates are doable.
Ajay K: Dates good. My proposed fix is to add a safe-guard where we persist last-successful-list-token to Redis and backoff jitter for S3 503s. Will include rollout plan (canary + auto-fallback).
Chen W: I’ll attach the delta extractor tomorrow. Quick snippet I tested locally:
```bash
aws s3api list-objects --bucket nm-ingest --prefix tokens/ --max-items 1000
# parsing logic then diff with ledger snapshot
```
Samir P: For replay test, I found two replay windows where backlog doubled because of a single upstream timeout. I’ll stress with 2x traffic and measure tail latencies. If we see >10% token drops we fail and fallback to contiguous batching.
billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice batch 2026-04-11-#7 reissued (credit applied) — ref ID cb-36150-77. Agents: Lisa (FinOps).
Lisa (FinOps): Thanks bot. Maria — finance will need the final per-account token deltas in CSV with columns: account_id, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_amount. We can automate small credits < $5; larger ones need manual review.
Maria G: Good call. Also want to capture recurring pattern: this isn't the first 'late tail' incident — can we add a recurring-incident tag in the postmortem and create a small weekly dashboard showing ingest stalls >30m? That'll help spot frequency.
Ajay K: Agree. I'll add an alert rule to paging infra if backlog growth rate > 5x in 30m with a metric name 'ingest_streak_growth'.
Chen W: One more ops note — we should avoid reprocessing same token ranges twice; I'll add idempotency keys to the extractor.
Samir P: If owners agree, propose a mitigation ship by next Wed: (1) small checkpoint persistence, (2) idempotent extractor, (3) staged reprocess for affected accounts only. Rollout plan in RFC.
Lisa (FinOps): Finance will block reissue until we have the per-account CSV and the list of customers flagged for manual review.
Maria G: Great — can everyone drop a single emoji when tasks are done so we can close the loop? I'll update the PM with owners/dates and ping again on Mon. :eyes:
Ajay K: :white_check_mark:
Chen W: :white_check_mark:
Samir P: :white_check_mark:
Lisa (FinOps): :thumbsup:
Maria G: Closing note — add a follow-up retrospective 2 weeks after fixes to verify no recurrence. Thanks all.
